newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil power companies begun.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil power companies begun.

text.p: Fator Securities on Friday said it had initiated coverage of Goias state power firms Cachoeira Dourada and CELG as a buy and a hold, respectively.
- Cachoeira Dourada, formally known as Centrais Eletricas de Cachoeira Dourada SA, and CELG resulted from the split of old Centrais Eletricas de Goias, the report said.
- Shares of Cachoeira Dourada began trading on July 21, the report said.
- Cachoeira Dourada will be privatized on September 5 for a minimum price of 543.4 million reais.
- Cachoeira Dourada preferred ended off 3.13 percent at 155 reais.
- CELG preferred shares closed up 8.86 percent at 98 reais.
